shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.typingHint: While typing, ? is entered as text. Sending shortcuts require focus in the message input.
shortcuts.pending: Wait for the current operation or inspect its uncertain result.
shortcuts.updateServer: The server must support automatic session titles.
shortcuts.creationRequired: Enter a message and select an Agent Worker and Runner Device.
shortcut-settings.scope: Saved on this computer. Changes take effect only after Save changes.
shortcut-settings.fixedHelp: Newline, guarded creation Enter, Search Enter, panel Escape, Tab and editing shortcuts keep their original behavior. Command or Control + K, N, T, W, Q, H, M and 1–9 remain reserved.
shortcut-settings.captureHelp: Press Command on macOS or Control on Windows/Linux, optionally Shift, with an ASCII letter, digit or Enter. Escape cancels capture.
shortcut-settings.invalid: Use one supported primary chord. Reserved, editing, repeated and composing keys cannot be assigned.
shortcut-settings.conflict: {{first}} and {{second}} use the same shortcut in an overlapping context.
shortcut-settings.changed: Shortcuts changed in another window. Discard this draft to use the verified settings before saving.
shortcut-settings.problem.unavailable: Shortcut persistence is unavailable here. Existing defaults remain available.
shortcut-settings.problem.read-failed: Saved shortcuts could not be read. Reinspect before saving.
shortcut-settings.problem.invalid-docume: The shortcut file is invalid and was left unchanged.
shortcut-settings.problem.unsupported-ve: The shortcut file uses an unsupported version and was left unchanged.
shortcut-settings.problem.write-failed: Shortcut settings could not be saved. Reinspect before another save.
shortcut-settings.problem.outcome-unknow: The save outcome is unknown. Reinspect without repeating the save.
shortcut-settings.problem.changed: The saved revision changed. Reinspect and discard the old draft before saving.
shortcut-settings.captureUncertain: Capture could not be confirmed. Cancel to inspect and end the original capture before trying again.
